Trip Details

  • CA$150.00

    Refund against receipts

Cruise across Canada in comfort when you rent an RV from CanaDream. Our Class C Motorhomes are perfect for families, friends or couples who want a little extra space.

Sleeping space for up to 4 adults and 2 small children, and kitchen featuring a large sink, fridge, three burner cooktop and a convection microwave oven - everything you need to cook a delicious meal on the go.

With our Saver 4 option Guests will receive CanaDream's choice of either a Maxi Motorhome MHA, Midi Motorhome MHB or Compact Motorhome MHC, depending on availability on day of pick up. 


Note for pick ups between Oct 1 and April 30 there is a possibility the unit will be winterized. Applies to all unit types except MHA.
